* Step 0.1 -- Inventory of the shipped tool surface

37 tools registered in =elot-gptel--tool-specs=.  Every spec has a
matching arm in =elot-gptel--tool-thunk=; every dispatcher arm has a
spec (37/37).  RO = read-only, MUT = mutating (has =:confirm t=),
MUT* = mutating in effect but spec has NO =:confirm t= (FINDING).

* Findings (feed Phase 1 / Phase 2)

1. *[P0 candidate -> Step 1.2 / 2.2]* =elot_rename_resource= and
   =elot_move_resource= are mutating tools but their specs carry NO
   =:confirm t=.  Every other mutator (delete, replace_with_parent,
   the three inserts, edit_axiom, edit_axioms, db_remove_source) does.
   Decide whether this is intentional (they are already gated by
   =elot-gptel-allow-side-effects=) or a missing confirm flag.  The
   registry meta-test (Step 1.2) should pin whichever answer we pick.

2. Spec <-> dispatcher parity is clean: 37 specs, 37 dispatcher arms,
   arities agree by inspection.  No orphan arms, no missing arms.

3. TODO (not yet done in this note): confirm each =:function= symbol
   is =fboundp= at load time, and capture =:enum= sets vs what each
   implementation validates (Step 1.2 / Step 1.3 input).
